title: Eldorado Gold Announces New Lamaque Technical Study Highlighting Significant Increased Economic Upside
description: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Feb.  24, 2022  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Eldorado Gold Corporation (“Eldorado”, the “Company” or “We”) (TSX: ELD) (NYSE: EGO) is pleased to announce the results of a new Technical Study (the “Study”) on its wholly-owned Lamaque Project, located in Val d’Or, Quebec. The Lamaque Project is comprised of three separate but contiguous properties: Lamaque South (containing the Upper Triangle zones, Lower Triangle zones, and the deposits of Parallel and Ormaque), Sigma-Lamaque and Aumaque (see Figures 1 and 2). The Upper Triangle zones within Lamaque South are currently being mined with access by surface ramp. The Study includes an update to the current operation, updated economics on the Upper Triangle zones (zones C1 through C5), as well as preliminary economic assessments on the inferred resources in the Lower Triangle zones (zones C6 through C10) and the Ormaque deposit.

title: Eldorado Gold Announces €680 Million Project Financing and Board Approval for the Skouries Project
description: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Dec.  15, 2022  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Eldorado Gold Corporation (“Eldorado” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Hellas Gold Single Member S.A. (“Hellas”) has entered into a €680 million project financing facility (the “Term Facility”) for the development of the Skouries Project in Northern Greece (“Skouries” or the “Project”) with National Bank of Greece S.A. (“National Bank of Greece”) and Piraeus Bank S.A. (“Piraeus Bank”) as lead arrangers. Consistent with the Company’s previous disclosure, the Term Facility will provide 80% of the expected future funding required to complete the Project, which is approximately half-built. The Term Facility is non-recourse to Eldorado and the collateral securing the Term Facility covers the Skouries Project and the Hellas operating assets. The remaining 20% of Project funding is expected to be fully covered by Eldorado’s existing cash and future cash flow from operations. Until such further equity is fully invested, Eldorado’s investment undertaking for the Project will be fully backstopped by a letter of credit from the Company’s Revolving Credit Facility. Drawdown on the Term Facility is subject to customary closing conditions. The Company expects such conditions to be satisfied and the initial drawdown to occur in the first quarter of 2023.

Gold prices, tracked by the SPDR Gold Trust (NYSE:GLD), edged above $2,110 per troy ounce on Monday, poised to achieve a record close and triggering a significant surge in mining stocks.
This marked the fourth consecutive session of gains for the precious metal, bringing it within 1.4 percent of the all-time high reached during the intraday session on Dec. 4, 2023.
Despite the rise in Treasury yields on Monday, with the yield on the 2-year Treasury note inching up to 4.60%, gold exhibited strength in the market.

title: 5 Yellow Metal Stocks to Buy for a Stable Portfolio in 2H 2024 - Zacks Investment Research
description: Gold prices jumped in 2024 due to increased geopolitical tensions, a weaker U.S. dollar, potential monetary policy easing, and continuous central bank buying. The gold mining industry is facing a scarcity of deposits, while demand is rising from sectors like energy, healthcare, and technology, as well as from India and China. This demand-supply imbalance is expected to drive gold prices higher.

title: U.S. Silica's (SLCA) Acquisition by Apollo Gets Shareholders' Nod - Zacks Investment Research
description: U.S. Silica Holdings, Inc. shareholders have approved the company's acquisition by funds managed by Apollo, a private investment firm. The all-cash transaction is expected to close by the end of the current quarter, after which U.S. Silica will go private and be delisted from the NYSE.

title: Suzano Closes 15% Stake Buyout Deal With Lenzing to Expand Business
description: Suzano S.A. announced that it closed the acquisition of a 15% stake in Lenzing, a global supplier of cellulosic fibers. This move will help Suzano expand into new markets and strengthen Lenzing's position as a global leader in sustainable fibers.

title: BHP's Copper Growth Plans Under Review by South Australian Government
description: BHP Group announced that the South Australian government has initiated an assessment of its planned Smelter and Refinery expansion at Olympic Dam. The expansion is expected to significantly increase BHP's copper production in the state by the early 2030s and mid-2030s.

title: Element Solutions Agrees to Divest MacDermid Graphics Solutions
description: Element Solutions Inc. has agreed to sell its flexographic printing plate business, MacDermid Graphics Solutions, to XSYS for an enterprise value of around $325 million. The transaction is expected to close in late 2024 or the first half of 2025.

title: Here's Why You Should Hold Onto Eastman Chemical Stock for Now
description: Eastman Chemical is benefiting from cost-cutting and productivity actions, as well as its innovation-driven growth strategy, despite challenges from soft demand in certain markets. The company is also focused on maintaining a disciplined approach to capital allocation with an emphasis on debt reduction.

title: PPG Industries to Exhibit Digital & Sustainable Solutions in Frankfurt
description: PPG Industries will showcase its latest digital tools and sustainable technologies at the Automechanika Frankfurt 2024 trade fair. The company's solutions aim to improve efficiency, precision, and sustainability in automotive refinishing.

title: FMC Shares Rise 10% in 3 Months: What's Driving the Stock?
description: FMC Corporation's shares have gained 9.6% over the past three months, outperforming its industry and the S&P 500. The company's better-than-expected Q2 results, new product launches, and cost-control actions are driving the stock's performance.

title: Here's Why You Should Hold Onto Air Products Stock for Now
description: Air Products & Chemicals is expected to benefit from its project investments, productivity actions, and new business deals, despite softness in China and Europe. The company remains focused on its gasification strategy and is executing its growth projects, which are expected to be accretive to earnings and cash flows.

title: Steel Dynamics Expects Lower Q3 Earnings Amid Pricing Pressures
description: Steel Dynamics expects lower Q3 earnings due to reduced average realized pricing in its flat rolled operations, which are contract-based and linked to lagging pricing indices. However, flat rolled steel prices have stabilized and demand remains consistent.

title: LyondellBasell & Dacia Develop Recycled Solution for Duster Model
description: LyondellBasell and Dacia have partnered to develop a recycled polypropylene compound for the exterior of the Dacia Duster model, showcasing their commitment to sustainability and modern design.

title: Cabot Chosen for $50M Award Negotiation to Aid Battery Supply Chain
description: Cabot Corporation has been selected by the U.S. Department of Energy for a $50 million award to develop a new manufacturing facility in the United States to produce battery-grade carbon nanotubes and conductive additive dispersions, which are crucial for the domestic lithium-ion battery supply chain.

title: Fission Uranium Awaits Court Decision on Acquisition by Paladin Energy
description: Fission Uranium has completed the hearing before the Supreme Court of British Columbia regarding the approval of the final order for its acquisition by Paladin Energy. The decision is expected in the coming weeks, but the acquisition remains opposed by CGN Mining, which holds an 11.26% stake in Fission.

title: Fortuna Silver's Gold Equivalent Production Dips 14% Y/Y in Q3
description: Fortuna Silver Mines Inc. reported a 13.9% decrease in gold equivalent production in Q3 2024 compared to the year-ago quarter. The company's gold and silver production also declined year-over-year. However, the company maintained its 2024 gold equivalent production guidance, indicating a potential year-over-year increase of 1-10%.
